column1: # The patch revisions that changed what a match computes (the simulation),
# oldest first. A game plays a replay only when every game of its recording
# was of the last one's revision or later: a recording of older games plays
# out otherwise in a newer one (session::v026g::replays, read at build time;
# A PR whose change makes a match play out otherwise (an exe patch of the
# game's rules, what a kit or a respawn is, ...) adds the row
# at the end: a PR never knows its revision. The release that ships it is
# that revision: its server takes `next` for its SRP_MIN_PATCH_REVISION
# (the release's own, set at its swap), and release/release.sh writes the
# number in place of `next` in its record. One `next` row at most: a second
# simulation change before the release adds its words to that row.

one double-handed gun unless use_two_double_handed_weapons 25), its ammunition replacing the swapped-out gun's until base_player::remove(1) puts the own gun and ammunition back, and the crate refills the borrowed gun's loaded stack by the game's bags rule (the weapon slot's bags, those of its own ammunition in the kit, in whole clips of the borrowed ammunition, less its magazine and chamber; never lowered; its other stacks left), for free; a bullet record always carries its quiet byte (+80h), whatever its ammo, and a loaded record's ammo ordinal past the gun now in its slot is none (exe patch 85: after a pickup's swap a record is read with another gun than the one that fired it); at base_player::remove(1), before the unload, the pick's slot gun empty with the record's own wear, each own stack's slot at its kit allowance, a slot only a borrowed stack went into empty), the picked gun starting its pick with a spawn's state (KIT_STATE_FIELDS and +5A4h, the spawn hook's seed of the picker's place, kit, slot and the switch's time), an untaken drop's gun kept 10 s past its drop's end and a world loaded with open drops or picks this game has no gun for having them cooked before the load, and the crate refills the borrowed gun's loaded stack by the game's bags rule (the weapon slot's bags, those of its own ammunition in the kit, in whole clips of the borrowed ammunition, less its magazine and chamber; never lowered; its other stacks left), for free; a bullet record always carries its quiet byte (+80h), whatever its ammo, and a loaded record's ammo ordinal past the gun now in its slot is none (exe patch 85: after a pickup's swap a record is read with another gun than the one that fired it); SCAR-H uses only dedicated 20-round AP ammunition (2266), with shared AP ballistics; compatibility with ordinary standard (51), shared AP (52), and standard-20 (2254) removed. Shared ammo and other weapons retain their stats and compatibility. Medicine influence amounts are course totals: orange Medikit pain relief 0.1333 -> 0.4 and yellow Science Medkit 0.1667 -> 0.5, restoring the intended 40% and 50% over their unchanged 3-second active duration after a 2-second delay. Other healing pools and medicines unchanged. Explicit tactical/empty reload times from 0.69 for the compared weapons (AK-12 unchanged); synchronized animation events and bot reload waits. Medical skills: stronger and longer painkillers, faster healing items, earlier regeneration, healing bonus, low-health movement, limb health and allied damage reduction; Larkspur shares its active effect within 5 metres, with an independently emitted native effect per recipient for rollback safety; at most six supply pockets within six quick positions; supply pocket capacity is at most five items after all bonuses

Medic sharing runs through real artefact activation and synchronized recipient state; boosters remain one per pocket. Keep bullet cutoff bounds independent of transient body insertion history. VSS and premium VSS magazine capacity increases from 10 to 20 rounds and minimum damage fraction from 0.6 to 0.8, retaining the 20/50 m falloff distances; tactical/empty reload times increase from 2.5/3.5 to 2.7/3.7 seconds (weapon-stats.tsv). FAMAS uses explicit 3-second tactical and 4-second empty reloads instead of a 4-second tactical time with an animation-derived empty duration. Vostok v0.11 day_2/day_4 uses the stock v0.26g Protective Device spawn layout: positions, rotations, priority and 28 points instead of 43 in both modes (including its three extra points per team in TDM).

Team Deathmatch kills score three times (the owner, 2026-11-04; static_info::TDM_KILL_FACTOR): in mode 4 the kill weight (event 0) the match is sent and the pay uses is 10 -> 30; the other events and modes keep theirs

a world takes no player input whose rotation no client makes (exe patch 99, 0.27d's "input is invalid"): game_world_core::change_input<player_input> 0x1FAB50 refuses, for every input (local, relayed, moved, a replay's), one whose half2 rotation has a half that is a NaN, an infinity or 1024 radians or more (the match server's PlayerInput::rotation_is_sane), returning 6 with nothing kept, so a world given one plays out without it; Weapon pickup: a player can take its own drop (the owner, 2026-11-05; the server relays a pickup naming its own place); a copy is its match's (the next match frees the copies of the one before, never taking another match's gun for a recipe); a rollback that names a pick again takes back the copy that pick took (before any older idle copy of the recipe); a copy whose cooked inventory no longer holds the gun it was made with (a refused restore left the picker's own gun parked there) is never handed out again (re-use, drops, loaded records), and an install refuses a weapon slot whose gun is a cooked copy's, so every client installs the recipe's gun; a thrown grenade stays above the ground (exe patch 105, docs/notes/grenade_ccd.md): grenade_core::load 0x303890 gives the grenade body continuous collision with a swept sphere of 0.04 m (was 0.01 m) inside its 0.05 m capsule, so a sweep that hits the level stops the capsule at the surface instead of 4 cm into it (where its contact often pushed it through the ground); the flight before the first hit is the same, a grenade rolls on less after it lands; the Groza hits a little softer and kicks up harder (the owner, 2026-11-05; weapon-stats.tsv): bullet_damage 0.42 -> 0.34 and top kick 1.2-1.5 -> 1.5-1.8 on wpn_ots14, so each shot's kick (weapon_recoil_calculator::on_shot 0x331C50, serialized with the weapon) differs;
